description: This file contains a PHP class defining a controller for the 'Topic' module in the OpenCart admin extension. It includes methods for displaying the module configuration page ('index') and saving its settings ('save'), managing breadcrumbs, rendering views, and handling permission checks.

classes.name: Opencart.Admin.Controller.Extension.Opencart.Module.Topic
classes.description: Controller class for managing the 'Topic' module in OpenCart's admin panel, providing methods to render the configuration page and save settings.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Handles displaying the module configuration page, setting up breadcrumbs, page title, and rendering the appropriate view.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Handles saving the module settings, including permission check, saving configuration, and returning JSON response.
